reason: A offers the more physically grounded and decisively testable mechanism—an elevated-temperature screw-to-edge transition with super-jogging tied directly to a strength plateau—whereas B speculatively links dislocation activity and unmeasured short-range order to elastic moduli and thermal expansion without a sound causal pathway or controlled ordering intervention. A is narrower and does not explain thermal expansion or elasticity, but its matched temperature-dependent observations and falsification criterion make it the stronger proposal.
